messages:
Aisha Patel: Hey team — prepping a cost + renewal health sync for NovaHealth before EOW. Quick status? Need onboarding blockers, spend drift, and any enablement requests.
Ben Ortega: Onboarding is ~90% — SSO + data pipeline final tasks. No technical blockers from infra side.
Casey Liu: Heads up: token usage spiked after their product demo. /embed route is main driver. If trend holds, run rate could be +25-30% month-over-month.
billing-bot: Billing Alert: NovaHealth projected to exceed monthly committed spend by 18% — current run rate $28,000 vs commit $24,000. (detail: https://billing.redwood/alerts/9932)
Diane Romero: Renewal risk = medium. They like the perf wins but cost sensitivity is there. Suggest we lead with batching + prefix KV cache and show a quantized model option for nightly batch jobs.
Aisha Patel: Agree. For the executive QBR deck we need 3 scenarios: current, optimization (batching+cache), and conservative (quantized model + Dedicated commit). Can we get numbers?
Casey Liu: I'll run the sim. Need their top prompt set + token histogram. @Diane can you export the top 10 prompts from their eval?
Diane Romero: Will pull and post a scrubbed snippet to #secure-cust-data. ETA 24 hours.
Ben Ortega: Also mention Dedicated reservation option — 6mo commit reduces unit cost ~10% and adds predictability. Good option if their usage stabilizes after optimizations.
Casey Liu: Ran a quick sim with yesterday's trace. Numbers below: ```
scenario,current,batching+cache,quantized+dedicated
monthly,$28,000,$18,000,$13,500
"
Aisha Patel: That delta is compelling. Capture customer ask: clearer per-feature token accounting (they want feature-level cost visibility). Add that to feedback.
Diane Romero: Action items: 1) Deck by Wed (Aisha), 2) Simulation artifacts + calc (Casey), 3) Workshop invite + Dedicated option doc (Ben), 4) Feature request for per-feature token billing (CS -> Eng).
Aisha Patel: Great — ping me when draft deck is uploaded. I'll coordinate invite for the workshop. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Ben Ortega: I'll draft the workshop agenda: 45m prompt engineering + 30m ops runbook (batching/kv/observability).
Casey Liu: I'll attach the sim CSV and a short write-up on assumptions once Diane posts prompts.
Diane Romero: Posting prompts now. Also logging the renewal sentiment in Gainsight (low/medium/high) as "medium" per convo.
Aisha Patel: Perfect. We'll use this in the client-facing cost playbook + slide. Closing thread unless new blockers pop up.
